title: Kashita Maryoku wa [Revo Barai] de Kyousei Choushuu

thread.title: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest! - Episode 5 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers enjoyed seeing the antagonistic former party receive consequences and welcomed the protagonist’s new partnership.
Several commenters found the new companion appealing and were interested in how her abilities might combine with the protagonist’s mana-based power.
The party name prompted amusement and discussion, though some considered it awkward or limiting.
The opening recap and reused footage were widely criticized as clumsy padding.
Some viewers thought the battle’s explanation of the enemy’s weakness was simplistic and poorly executed.

notes: The Reddit thread clearly matches the exact show and Episode 5; the title uses the English alternate title while the post identifies the Kashita Maryoku wa [Revo Barai] de Kyousei Choushuu title.
